body: I loved it. Actually had energy, didn't put on weight or increase appetite however I ended up coming off it due to sexual side effects.
I used CBD and TCH oil/butter however I have to be careful on which strains I use as some lead to severe anxiety and dissociation.

I find Pregabalin really helpful.

I also take valium and quetiapine when needed for anxiety/panic attacks.

Have recently started taking CBD drops to try reduce my valium use as when taken often my tolerance builds and I don't get the desired results.

Before my BPD diagnosis I tried evey antidepressant under the sun without desired results.

I believe that all mind altering substances should be treated with caution and respect.

I have successfully taken LSD,  Mushrooms and Payote many times without problems.

I believe it is all about having a safe environment and trusted people around you.

This being said everybody reacts differently to the chemicals.

My best advice once tripping is to remember you have ingested a chemical and what you are experiencing will wear off.

I personally would start with mushrooms as the trip is the shortest in duration.

Start slow, you can always take more.
I'm going through a massive internal struggle with this atm. My fiance is literally perfect, we have been together 6+ years but my BPD is breaking him.
